Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition typevar : Set := var.

Definition termvar : Set := var.

Definition castvar : Set := var.

Definition label : Set := nat.

Definition int : Set := nat.

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | t_var_b : nat -> typ
 | t_var_f : typevar -> typ
 | t_int : typ
 | t_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
 | t_mu : typ -> typ  .

Inductive castop : Set :=
 | c_var_b : nat -> castop
 | c_var_f : castvar -> castop
 | c_id : castop
 | c_unfold : typ -> castop
 | c_fold : typ -> castop
 | c_arrow : castop -> castop -> castop
 | c_seq : castop -> castop -> castop
 | c_fixc : castop -> castop  .

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | e_var_b : nat -> exp
 | e_var_f : termvar -> exp
 | e_lit : int -> exp
 | e_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
 | e_app : exp -> exp -> exp
 | e_cast : castop -> exp -> exp.

Definition ctx : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Definition tctx : Set := list ( atom * unit ).

Definition actx : Set := list ((typ * typ)).

Definition cctx : Set := list ( atom * (typ * typ)).

Fixpoint open_typ_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:typ) (A_6:typ) {struct A_6}: typ :=
  match A_6 with
  | (t_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => t_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => A5
        | inright _ => t_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (t_var_f X) => t_var_f X
  | t_int => t_int
  | (t_arrow A B) => t_arrow (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A) (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 B)
  | (t_mu A) => t_mu (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec (S k) A5 A)
end.

Fixpoint open_castop_wrt_castop_rec (k:nat) (c_5:castop) (c__6:castop) {struct c__6}: castop :=
  match c__6 with
  | (c_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => c_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => c_5
        | inright _ => c_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold A
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold A
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec (S k) c_5 c)
end.

Fixpoint open_castop_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:typ) (c_5:castop) {struct c_5}: castop :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c)
end.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => e_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => e_5
        | inright _ => e_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast c (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e)
end.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_castop_rec (k:nat) (c5:castop) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5}: exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (open_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c5 c) (open_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e)
end.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:typ) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5}: exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A) (open_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (open_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c) (open_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e)
end.

Definition open_castop_wrt_typ A5 c_5 := open_castop_wrt_typ_rec 0 c_5 A5.

Definition open_exp_wrt_exp e_5 e__6 := open_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition open_exp_wrt_castop c5 e_5 := open_exp_wrt_castop_rec 0 e_5 c5.

Definition open_castop_wrt_castop c_5 c__6 := open_castop_wrt_castop_rec 0 c__6 c_5.

Definition open_typ_wrt_typ A5 A_6 := open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 A_6 A5.

Definition open_exp_wrt_typ A5 e_5 := open_exp_wrt_typ_rec 0 e_5 A5.

Fixpoint close_typ_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:var) (A_6:typ) {struct A_6}: typ :=
  match A_6 with
  | (t_var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then t_var_b nat
         else t_var_b (S nat)
  | (t_var_f X) => if (A5 === X) then (t_var_b k) else (t_var_f X)
  | t_int => t_int
  | (t_arrow A B) => t_arrow (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A) (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 B)
  | (t_mu A) => t_mu (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec (S k) A5 A)
end.

Fixpoint close_castop_wrt_castop_rec (k:nat) (c_5:var) (c__6:castop) {struct c__6}: castop :=
  match c__6 with
  | (c_var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then c_var_b nat
         else c_var_b (S nat)
  | (c_var_f cx) => if (c_5 === cx) then (c_var_b k) else (c_var_f cx)
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold A
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold A
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec (S k) c_5 c)
end.

Fixpoint close_castop_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:var) (c_5:castop) {struct c_5}: castop :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c)
end.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:var) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then e_var_b nat
         else e_var_b (S nat)
  | (e_var_f x) => if (e_5 === x) then (e_var_b k) else (e_var_f x)
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast c (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e)
end.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_castop_rec (k:nat) (c5:var) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5}: exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e1) (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c5 c) (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e)
end.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:var) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5}: exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A) (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e1) (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c) (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e)
end.

Definition close_castop_wrt_typ c_5 A5 := close_castop_wrt_typ_rec 0 c_5 A5.

Definition close_exp_wrt_exp e__6 e_5 := close_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition close_exp_wrt_castop e_5 c5 := close_exp_wrt_castop_rec 0 e_5 c5.

Definition close_castop_wrt_castop c__6 c_5 := close_castop_wrt_castop_rec 0 c__6 c_5.

Definition close_typ_wrt_typ A_6 A5 := close_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 A_6 A5.

Definition close_exp_wrt_typ e_5 A5 := close_exp_wrt_typ_rec 0 e_5 A5.

Inductive lc_typ : typ -> Prop :=
 | lc_t_var_f : forall (X:typevar),
     (lc_typ (t_var_f X))
 | lc_t_int :
     (lc_typ t_int)
 | lc_t_arrow : forall (A B:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_typ B) ->
     (lc_typ (t_arrow A B))
 | lc_t_mu : forall (A:typ),
      ( forall X , lc_typ  ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  ->
     (lc_typ (t_mu A)).

Inductive lc_castop : castop -> Prop :=
 | lc_c_var_f : forall (cx:castvar),
     (lc_castop (c_var_f cx))
 | lc_c_id :
     (lc_castop c_id)
 | lc_c_unfold : forall (A:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_castop (c_unfold A))
 | lc_c_fold : forall (A:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_castop (c_fold A))
 | lc_c_arrow : forall (c1 c2:castop),
     (lc_castop c1) ->
     (lc_castop c2) ->
     (lc_castop (c_arrow c1 c2))
 | lc_c_seq : forall (c1 c2:castop),
     (lc_castop c1) ->
     (lc_castop c2) ->
     (lc_castop (c_seq c1 c2))
 | lc_c_fixc : forall (c:castop),
      ( forall cx , lc_castop  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
     (lc_castop (c_fixc c)).

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_e_var_f : forall (x:termvar),
     (lc_exp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_lit : forall (i:int),
     (lc_exp (e_lit i))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     (lc_typ A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_abs A e))
 | lc_e_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_app e1 e2))
 | lc_e_cast : forall (c:castop) (e:exp),
     (lc_castop c) ->
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (e_cast c e)).

Fixpoint typefv_typ (A5:typ) : vars :=
  match A5 with
  | (t_var_b nat) => {}
  | (t_var_f X) => {{X}}
  | t_int => {}
  | (t_arrow A B) => (typefv_typ A) \u (typefv_typ B)
  | (t_mu A) => (typefv_typ A)
end.

Fixpoint castfv_castop (c_5:castop) : vars :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => {}
  | (c_var_f cx) => {{cx}}
  | c_id => {}
  | (c_unfold A) => {}
  | (c_fold A) => {}
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => (castfv_castop c1) \u (castfv_castop c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => (castfv_castop c1) \u (castfv_castop c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => (castfv_castop c)
end.

Fixpoint typefv_castop (c_5:castop) : vars :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => {}
  | (c_var_f cx) => {}
  | c_id => {}
  | (c_unfold A) => (typefv_typ A)
  | (c_fold A) => (typefv_typ A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => (typefv_castop c1) \u (typefv_castop c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => (typefv_castop c1) \u (typefv_castop c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => (typefv_castop c)
end.

Fixpoint termfv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (termfv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (termfv_exp e1) \u (termfv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (termfv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint castfv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=

  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (castfv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (castfv_exp e1) \u (castfv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (castfv_castop c) \u (castfv_exp e)
end.

  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {}
  | (e_lit i) => {}

Notation unfold_mu t :=

Inductive WFT : tctx -> typ -> Prop :=
 | WFT_int : forall (D:tctx),
     WFT D t_int
 | WFT_var : forall (D:tctx) (X:typevar),
      X  `in` (dom  D )  ->
     WFT D (t_var_f X)
 | WFT_arrow : forall (D:tctx) (A B:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     WFT D (t_arrow A B)
 | WFT_rec : forall (L:vars) (D:tctx) (A:typ),
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> WFT  (cons ( X ,tt )  D )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  ->
     WFT D (t_mu A).

Inductive WFTyE : tctx -> Prop :=
 | WFTyE_empty :
     WFTyE  nil
 | WFTyE_cons : forall (D:tctx) (X:typevar),
     WFTyE D ->
      X  `notin` (dom  D )  ->
     WFTyE  (cons ( X ,tt )  D ) .

Inductive TypCast : tctx -> cctx -> typ -> typ -> castop -> Prop :=
 | TCast_id : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E A A c_id
 | TCast_arrow : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A1 B1 A2 B2:typ) (c1 c2:castop),
     TypCast D E A1 A2 c1 ->
     TypCast D E B1 B2 c2 ->
     TypCast D E (t_arrow A1 B1) (t_arrow A2 B2) (c_arrow c1 c2)
 | TCast_unfold : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (c_unfold (t_mu A))
 | TCast_fold : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (t_mu A) (c_fold (t_mu A))
 | TCast_seq : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A C:typ) (c1 c2:castop) (B:typ),
     TypCast D E A B c1 ->
     TypCast D E B C c2 ->
     TypCast D E A C (c_seq c1 c2)
 | TCast_var : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A B:typ) (cx:castvar),
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
      uniq  E  ->
      In ( cx , ( A ,  B ))  E  ->
     TypCast D E A B (c_var_f cx)
 | TCast_fix : forall (L:vars) (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A1 B1 A2 B2:typ) (c1 c2:castop),
      ( forall cx , cx \notin  L  -> TypCast D  (cons ( cx , ( (t_arrow A1 B1) ,  (t_arrow A2 B2) ))  E )  A1 A2  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c1 (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
      ( forall cx , cx \notin  L  -> TypCast D  (cons ( cx , ( (t_arrow A1 B1) ,  (t_arrow A2 B2) ))  E )  B1 B2  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c2 (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
     TypCast D E (t_arrow A1 B1) (t_arrow A2 B2) (c_fixc  (c_arrow c1 c2) ).

Inductive WFTmE : ctx -> Prop :=
 | WFTmE_empty :
     WFTmE  nil
 | WFTmE_cons : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
     WFT  nil  A ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  G )  ->
     WFTmE  (cons ( x , A )  G ) .

Inductive Typing : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | Typing_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     Typing G (e_lit i) t_int
 | Typing_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     Typing G (e_var_f x) A
 | Typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A1:typ) (e:exp) (A2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (cons ( x , A1 )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A2 )  ->
     Typing G (e_abs A1 e) (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | Typing_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A2 A1:typ),
     Typing G e1 (t_arrow A1 A2) ->
     Typing G e2 A1 ->
     Typing G (e_app e1 e2) A2
 | Typing_cast : forall (G:ctx) (c:castop) (e:exp) (B A:typ),
     Typing G e A ->
     TypCast  nil   nil  A B c ->
     Typing G (e_cast c e) B.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | V_lit : forall (i:int),
     value (e_lit i)
 | V_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_exp (e_abs A e) ->
     value  ( (e_abs A e) )
 | V_fold : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     value e ->
     value  ( (e_cast (c_fold A) e) )
 | V_arrow : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop c1 ->
     lc_castop c2 ->
     value e ->
     value  ( (e_cast (c_arrow c1 c2) e) ) .

Inductive Reduction : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | Red_beta : forall (A:typ) (e e':exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_exp (e_abs A e) ->
     value e' ->
     Reduction (e_app  ( (e_abs A e) )  e')  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e e' )
 | Red_appl : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     Reduction e1 e1' ->
     Reduction (e_app e1 e2) (e_app e1' e2)
 | Red_appr : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     Reduction e2 e2' ->
     Reduction (e_app v1 e2) (e_app v1 e2')
 | Red_cast_arr : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e1 e2:exp),
     lc_castop c2 ->
     lc_castop c1 ->
     value e1 ->
     value e2 ->
     Reduction (e_app  ( (e_cast (c_arrow c1 c2) e1) )  e2) (e_cast c2  ( (e_app e1  ( (e_cast  (rev_cast  c1 )  e2) ) ) ) )
 | Red_cast_seq : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop c2 ->
     lc_castop c1 ->
     value e ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_seq c1 c2) e) (e_cast c2  ( (e_cast c1 e) ) )
 | Red_cast : forall (c:castop) (e e':exp),
     lc_castop c ->
     Reduction e e' ->
     Reduction (e_cast c e) (e_cast c e')
 | Red_castelim : forall (A:typ) (v:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     value v ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_unfold A)  ( (e_cast (c_fold A) v) ) ) v
 | Red_castid : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     Reduction (e_cast c_id v) v
 | Red_castfix : forall (c:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop (c_fixc c) ->
     value e ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_fixc c) e) (e_cast  (open_castop_wrt_castop  c   (c_fixc c) )  e).

Inductive eqe2 : tctx -> actx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | e2_assump : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A B:typ),
      In ( A ,  B )  H  ->
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     eqe2 D H A B
 | e2_refl : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     eqe2 D H A A
 | e2_trans : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A C B:typ),
     eqe2 D H A B ->
     eqe2 D H B C ->
     eqe2 D H A C
 | e2_symm : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (B A:typ),
     eqe2 D H A B ->
     eqe2 D H B A
 | e2_fld : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
     eqe2 D H (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )
 | e2_arrfix : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     eqe2 D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A1 B1 ->
     eqe2 D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A2 B2 ->
     eqe2 D H (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2).

Inductive EquiTyping : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | ETyping_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     EquiTyping G (e_lit i) t_int
 | ETyping_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     EquiTyping G (e_var_f x) A
 | ETyping_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A1:typ) (e:exp) (A2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> EquiTyping  (cons ( x , A1 )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A2 )  ->
     EquiTyping G (e_abs A1 e) (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | ETyping_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A2 A1:typ),
     EquiTyping G e1 (t_arrow A1 A2) ->
     EquiTyping G e2 A1 ->
     EquiTyping G (e_app e1 e2) A2
 | ETyping_eq : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (B A:typ),
     EquiTyping G e A ->
     eqe2  nil   nil  A B ->
     EquiTyping G e B.

Inductive EquiTypingC : ctx -> exp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
 | ECTyping_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     EquiTypingC G (e_lit i) t_int (e_lit i)
 | ECTyping_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     EquiTypingC G (e_var_f x) A (e_var_f x)
 | ECTyping_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A1:typ) (e:exp) (A2:typ) (e':exp),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> EquiTypingC  (cons ( x , A1 )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A2  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e' (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     EquiTypingC G (e_abs A1 e) (t_arrow A1 A2) (e_abs A1 e')
 | ECTyping_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A2:typ) (e1' e2':exp) (A1:typ),
     EquiTypingC G e1 (t_arrow A1 A2) e1' ->
     EquiTypingC G e2 A1 e2' ->
     EquiTypingC G (e_app e1 e2) A2 (e_app e1' e2')
 | ECTyping_eq : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (B:typ) (c:castop) (e':exp) (A:typ),
     EquiTypingC G e A e' ->
     TypCast  nil   nil  A B c ->
     EquiTypingC G e B (e_cast c e').

  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c_5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec (S k) c_5 c)
end.

Fixpoint close_castop_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:var) (c_5:castop) {struct c_5}: castop :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c1) (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c)
end.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:var) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
       if (lt_dec nat k)
         then e_var_b nat
         else e_var_b (S nat)
  | (e_var_f x) => if (e_5 === x) then (e_var_b k) else (e_var_f x)
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast c (close_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e)
end.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_castop_rec (k:nat) (c5:var) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5}: exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e1) (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k c5 c) (close_exp_wrt_castop_rec k c5 e)
end.

Fixpoint close_exp_wrt_typ_rec (k:nat) (A5:var) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5}: exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs (close_typ_wrt_typ_rec k A5 A) (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e1) (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (close_castop_wrt_typ_rec k A5 c) (close_exp_wrt_typ_rec k A5 e)
end.

Definition close_castop_wrt_typ c_5 A5 := close_castop_wrt_typ_rec 0 c_5 A5.

Definition close_exp_wrt_exp e__6 e_5 := close_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition close_exp_wrt_castop e_5 c5 := close_exp_wrt_castop_rec 0 e_5 c5.

Definition close_castop_wrt_castop c__6 c_5 := close_castop_wrt_castop_rec 0 c__6 c_5.

Definition close_typ_wrt_typ A_6 A5 := close_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 A_6 A5.

Definition close_exp_wrt_typ e_5 A5 := close_exp_wrt_typ_rec 0 e_5 A5.

Inductive lc_typ : typ -> Prop :=
 | lc_t_var_f : forall (X:typevar),
     (lc_typ (t_var_f X))
 | lc_t_int :
     (lc_typ t_int)
 | lc_t_arrow : forall (A B:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_typ B) ->
     (lc_typ (t_arrow A B))
 | lc_t_mu : forall (A:typ),
      ( forall X , lc_typ  ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  ->
     (lc_typ (t_mu A)).

Inductive lc_castop : castop -> Prop :=
 | lc_c_var_f : forall (cx:castvar),
     (lc_castop (c_var_f cx))
 | lc_c_id :
     (lc_castop c_id)
 | lc_c_unfold : forall (A:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_castop (c_unfold A))
 | lc_c_fold : forall (A:typ),
     (lc_typ A) ->
     (lc_castop (c_fold A))
 | lc_c_arrow : forall (c1 c2:castop),
     (lc_castop c1) ->
     (lc_castop c2) ->
     (lc_castop (c_arrow c1 c2))
 | lc_c_seq : forall (c1 c2:castop),
     (lc_castop c1) ->
     (lc_castop c2) ->
     (lc_castop (c_seq c1 c2))
 | lc_c_fixc : forall (c:castop),
      ( forall cx , lc_castop  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
     (lc_castop (c_fixc c)).

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_e_var_f : forall (x:termvar),
     (lc_exp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_lit : forall (i:int),
     (lc_exp (e_lit i))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     (lc_typ A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_abs A e))
 | lc_e_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_app e1 e2))
 | lc_e_cast : forall (c:castop) (e:exp),
     (lc_castop c) ->
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (e_cast c e)).

Fixpoint typefv_typ (A5:typ) : vars :=

  | (t_var_b nat) => {}
  | (t_var_f X) => {{X}}
  | t_int => {}
  | (t_arrow A B) => (typefv_typ A) \u (typefv_typ B)
  | (t_mu A) => (typefv_typ A)
end.

Fixpoint castfv_castop (c_5:castop) : vars :=

  | (c_var_b nat) => {}
  | (c_var_f cx) => {{cx}}
  | c_id => {}
  | (c_unfold A) => {}
  | (c_fold A) => {}
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => (castfv_castop c1) \u (castfv_castop c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => (castfv_castop c1) \u (castfv_castop c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => (castfv_castop c)
end.

Fixpoint typefv_castop (c_5:castop) : vars :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => {}
  | (c_var_f cx) => {}
  | c_id => {}
  | (c_unfold A) => (typefv_typ A)
  | (c_fold A) => (typefv_typ A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => (typefv_castop c1) \u (typefv_castop c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => (typefv_castop c1) \u (typefv_castop c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => (typefv_castop c)

Fixpoint termfv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}

  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (termfv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (termfv_exp e1) \u (termfv_exp e2)

Fixpoint castfv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (castfv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (castfv_exp e1) \u (castfv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (castfv_castop c) \u (castfv_exp e)

Fixpoint typefv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {}
  | (e_lit i) => {}
  | (e_abs A e) => (typefv_typ A) \u (typefv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (typefv_exp e1) \u (typefv_exp e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => (typefv_castop c) \u (typefv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint typsubst_typ (A5:typ) (X5:typevar) (A_6:typ) {struct A_6} : typ :=
  match A_6 with
  | (t_var_b nat) => t_var_b nat
  | (t_var_f X) => (if eq_var X X5 then A5 else (t_var_f X))
  | t_int => t_int
  | (t_arrow A B) => t_arrow (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A) (typsubst_typ A5 X5 B)
  | (t_mu A) => t_mu (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A)
end.

Fixpoint castsubst_castop (c_5:castop) (cx5:castvar) (c__6:castop) {struct c__6} : castop :=
  match c__6 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => (if eq_var cx cx5 then c_5 else (c_var_f cx))
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold A
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold A
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c1) (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c1) (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (castsubst_castop c_5 cx5 c)
end.

Fixpoint typsubst_castop (A5:typ) (X5:typevar) (c_5:castop) {struct c_5} : castop :=
  match c_5 with
  | (c_var_b nat) => c_var_b nat
  | (c_var_f cx) => c_var_f cx
  | c_id => c_id
  | (c_unfold A) => c_unfold (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A)
  | (c_fold A) => c_fold (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A)
  | (c_arrow c1 c2) => c_arrow (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c1) (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c2)
  | (c_seq c1 c2) => c_seq (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c1) (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c2)
  | (c_fixc c) => c_fixc (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c)
end.

Fixpoint subst_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:termvar) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then e_5 else (e_var_f x))
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (subst_exp e_5 x5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast c (subst_exp e_5 x5 e)
end.

Fixpoint castsubst_exp (c5:castop) (cx5:castvar) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5} : exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs A (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e1) (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (castsubst_castop c5 cx5 c) (castsubst_exp c5 cx5 e)
end.

Fixpoint typsubst_exp (A5:typ) (X5:typevar) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5} : exp :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i) => e_lit i
  | (e_abs A e) => e_abs (typsubst_typ A5 X5 A) (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e1) (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e2)
  | (e_cast c e) => e_cast (typsubst_castop A5 X5 c) (typsubst_exp A5 X5 e)
end.

Fixpoint rev_cast (c:castop) :=
  match c with
  | c_id => c_id
  | c_arrow c1 c2 => c_arrow (rev_cast c1) (rev_cast c2)
  | c_fixc c => c_fixc (rev_cast c)
  | c_unfold t => c_fold t
  | c_fold t => c_unfold t
  | c_seq c1 c2 => c_seq (rev_cast c2) (rev_cast c1)
  | c_var_f x => c_var_f x
  | c_var_b x => c_var_b x
  end.

Notation unfold_mu t :=
    (open_typ_wrt_typ t (t_mu t)).

Inductive WFT : tctx -> typ -> Prop :=
 | WFT_int : forall (D:tctx),
     WFT D t_int
 | WFT_var : forall (D:tctx) (X:typevar),
      X  `in` (dom  D )  ->
     WFT D (t_var_f X)
 | WFT_arrow : forall (D:tctx) (A B:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     WFT D (t_arrow A B)
 | WFT_rec : forall (L:vars) (D:tctx) (A:typ),
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> WFT  (cons ( X ,tt )  D )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (t_var_f X) )  )  ->
     WFT D (t_mu A).

Inductive WFTyE : tctx -> Prop :=
 | WFTyE_empty :
     WFTyE  nil
 | WFTyE_cons : forall (D:tctx) (X:typevar),
     WFTyE D ->
      X  `notin` (dom  D )  ->
     WFTyE  (cons ( X ,tt )  D ) .

Inductive TypCast : tctx -> cctx -> typ -> typ -> castop -> Prop :=
 | TCast_id : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E A A c_id
 | TCast_arrow : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A1 B1 A2 B2:typ) (c1 c2:castop),
     TypCast D E A1 A2 c1 ->
     TypCast D E B1 B2 c2 ->
     TypCast D E (t_arrow A1 B1) (t_arrow A2 B2) (c_arrow c1 c2)
 | TCast_unfold : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (c_unfold (t_mu A))
 | TCast_fold : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
      uniq  E  ->
     TypCast D E  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )  (t_mu A) (c_fold (t_mu A))
 | TCast_seq : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A C:typ) (c1 c2:castop) (B:typ),
     TypCast D E A B c1 ->
     TypCast D E B C c2 ->
     TypCast D E A C (c_seq c1 c2)
 | TCast_var : forall (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A B:typ) (cx:castvar),
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
      uniq  E  ->
      In ( cx , ( A ,  B ))  E  ->
     TypCast D E A B (c_var_f cx)
 | TCast_fix : forall (L:vars) (D:tctx) (E:cctx) (A1 B1 A2 B2:typ) (c1 c2:castop),
      ( forall cx , cx \notin  L  -> TypCast D  (cons ( cx , ( (t_arrow A1 B1) ,  (t_arrow A2 B2) ))  E )  A1 A2  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c1 (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
      ( forall cx , cx \notin  L  -> TypCast D  (cons ( cx , ( (t_arrow A1 B1) ,  (t_arrow A2 B2) ))  E )  B1 B2  ( open_castop_wrt_castop c2 (c_var_f cx) )  )  ->
     TypCast D E (t_arrow A1 B1) (t_arrow A2 B2) (c_fixc  (c_arrow c1 c2) ).

Inductive WFTmE : ctx -> Prop :=
 | WFTmE_empty :
     WFTmE  nil
 | WFTmE_cons : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
     WFT  nil  A ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  G )  ->
     WFTmE  (cons ( x , A )  G ) .

Inductive Typing : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | Typing_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     Typing G (e_lit i) t_int
 | Typing_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     Typing G (e_var_f x) A
 | Typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A1:typ) (e:exp) (A2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (cons ( x , A1 )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A2 )  ->
     Typing G (e_abs A1 e) (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | Typing_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A2 A1:typ),
     Typing G e1 (t_arrow A1 A2) ->
     Typing G e2 A1 ->
     Typing G (e_app e1 e2) A2
 | Typing_cast : forall (G:ctx) (c:castop) (e:exp) (B A:typ),
     Typing G e A ->
     TypCast  nil   nil  A B c ->
     Typing G (e_cast c e) B.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | V_lit : forall (i:int),
     value (e_lit i)
 | V_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_exp (e_abs A e) ->
     value  ( (e_abs A e) )
 | V_fold : forall (A:typ) (e:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     value e ->
     value  ( (e_cast (c_fold A) e) )
 | V_arrow : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop c1 ->
     lc_castop c2 ->
     value e ->
     value  ( (e_cast (c_arrow c1 c2) e) ) .

Inductive Reduction : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | Red_beta : forall (A:typ) (e e':exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     lc_exp (e_abs A e) ->
     value e' ->
     Reduction (e_app  ( (e_abs A e) )  e')  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e e' )
 | Red_appl : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     Reduction e1 e1' ->
     Reduction (e_app e1 e2) (e_app e1' e2)
 | Red_appr : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     Reduction e2 e2' ->
     Reduction (e_app v1 e2) (e_app v1 e2')
 | Red_cast_arr : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e1 e2:exp),
     lc_castop c2 ->
     lc_castop c1 ->
     value e1 ->
     value e2 ->
     Reduction (e_app  ( (e_cast (c_arrow c1 c2) e1) )  e2) (e_cast c2  ( (e_app e1  ( (e_cast  (rev_cast  c1 )  e2) ) ) ) )
 | Red_cast_seq : forall (c1 c2:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop c2 ->
     lc_castop c1 ->
     value e ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_seq c1 c2) e) (e_cast c2  ( (e_cast c1 e) ) )
 | Red_cast : forall (c:castop) (e e':exp),
     lc_castop c ->
     Reduction e e' ->
     Reduction (e_cast c e) (e_cast c e')
 | Red_castelim : forall (A:typ) (v:exp),
     lc_typ A ->
     value v ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_unfold A)  ( (e_cast (c_fold A) v) ) ) v
 | Red_castid : forall (v:exp),
     value v ->
     Reduction (e_cast c_id v) v
 | Red_castfix : forall (c:castop) (e:exp),
     lc_castop (c_fixc c) ->
     value e ->
     Reduction (e_cast (c_fixc c) e) (e_cast  (open_castop_wrt_castop  c   (c_fixc c) )  e).

Inductive eqe2 : tctx -> actx -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | e2_assump : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A B:typ),
      In ( A ,  B )  H  ->
     WFT D A ->
     WFT D B ->
     eqe2 D H A B
 | e2_refl : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D A ->
     eqe2 D H A A
 | e2_trans : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A C B:typ),
     eqe2 D H A B ->
     eqe2 D H B C ->
     eqe2 D H A C
 | e2_symm : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (B A:typ),
     eqe2 D H A B ->
     eqe2 D H B A
 | e2_fld : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A:typ),
     WFT D (t_mu A) ->
     eqe2 D H (t_mu A)  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A (t_mu A) )
 | e2_arrfix : forall (D:tctx) (H:actx) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     eqe2 D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A1 B1 ->
     eqe2 D  (cons ( (t_arrow A1 A2) ,  (t_arrow B1 B2) )  H )  A2 B2 ->
     eqe2 D H (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2).

Inductive EquiTyping : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | ETyping_int : forall (G:ctx) (i:int),
     WFTmE G ->
     EquiTyping G (e_lit i) t_int
 | ETyping_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:termvar) (A:typ),
     WFTmE G ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     EquiTyping G (e_var_f x) A
 | ETyping_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A1:typ) (e:exp) (A2:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> EquiTyping  (cons ( x , A1 )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A2 )  ->
     EquiTyping G (e_abs A1 e) (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | ETyping_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A2 A1:typ),
     EquiTyping G e1 (t_arrow A1 A2) ->
     EquiTyping G e2 A1 ->

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic context helpers                                        *)

Definition flip_pair (p : typ * typ) : typ * typ := (snd p, fst p).

Definition flip_ctx (E : cctx) : cctx := map flip_pair E.

     (exists x, In (x,p) E) /\ (exists y, In (y, flip_pair p) E)).

Lemma flip_pair_invol : forall p, flip_pair (flip_pair p) = p.
Proof. intros [a b]. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_pair_eq : forall A B, flip_pair (A,B) = (B,A).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma in_flip_ctx : forall E x p,
  In (x,p) (flip_ctx E) <-> In (x, flip_pair p) E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold flip_ctx. split.
  - intros H. apply binds_map_3 in H.
    destruct H as [q [Heq Hin]]. subst. rewrite flip_pair_invol. exact Hin.
  - intros H. apply binds_map. rewrite flip_pair_invol. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma in_flip_ctx_inv : forall E x A B,
  In (x,(A,B)) E -> In (x,(B,A)) (flip_ctx E).
Proof.
  intros. apply in_flip_ctx. simpl. rewrite flip_pair_eq. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_flip_ctx : forall E, uniq E -> uniq (flip_ctx E).
Proof. intros. apply uniq_map_2. exact H. Qed.

Lemma realizes_uniq : forall H E, realizes H E -> uniq E.
Proof. intros H E [Hu _]. exact Hu. Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Weakening for eqe2                                           *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma eqe2_weaken : forall D H A B,
  eqe2 D H A B -> forall H', (forall p, In p H -> In p H') -> eqe2 D H' A B.
Proof.
  intros D H A B Hd.
  induction Hd; intros H' Hin.
  - apply e2_assump; auto.
  - apply e2_refl; auto.
  - eapply e2_trans; eauto.
  - apply e2_symm; auto.
  - apply e2_fld; auto.
  - apply e2_arrfix.
    + apply IHHd1. intros p Hp.
      simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Heq | Hp].
      * left. exact Heq.
      * right. apply Hin. exact Hp.
    + apply IHHd2. intros p Hp.
      simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Heq | Hp].
      * left. exact Heq.
      * right. apply Hin. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Soundness                                                    *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma TypCast_sound_gen : forall D E A B c,
  TypCast D E A B c ->
  forall H, (forall x p, In (x,p) E -> In p H) -> eqe2 D H A B.
Proof.

  induction Ht; intros H Hin.
  - (* id *) apply e2_refl; auto.
  - (* arrow *)

    + apply eqe2_weaken with (H := H).

      * intros p Hp. simpl. right. exact Hp.

      * intros p Hp. simpl. right. exact Hp.
  - (* unfold *) apply e2_fld; auto.
  - (* fold *) apply e2_symm. apply e2_fld; auto.
  - (* seq *) eapply e2_trans; eauto.

    + auto.

        -- right. apply Hin. exact Hinp.
Qed.

Theorem TypCast_soundness: forall D A B c,
  TypCast D nil A B c ->

Proof.
  intros. apply TypCast_sound_gen with (E := nil) (H := nil).
  - exact H.
  - intros x p Hnil. inversion Hnil.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Locally closed cast operators (no free bound variables)      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint lc_b (k:nat) (c:castop) {struct c} : Prop :=
  match c with
  | c_var_b n => n < k
  | c_var_f _ => True
  | c_id => True
  | c_unfold _ => True
  | c_fold _ => True
  | c_arrow c1 c2 => lc_b k c1 /\ lc_b k c2
  | c_seq c1 c2 => lc_b k c1 /\ lc_b k c2
  | c_fixc c => lc_b (S k) c
  end.

Lemma lc_b_mono : forall c k k', lc_b k c -> k <= k' -> lc_b k' c.
Proof.
  induction c; intros k k' H Hle; simpl in *; auto; try lia.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHc1 with (k:=k)|apply IHc2 with (k:=k)]; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHc1 with (k:=k)|apply IHc2 with (k:=k)]; auto.
  - apply IHc with (k:=S k). exact H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma lc_b_open_id : forall c k m v,
  lc_b k c -> open_castop_wrt_castop_rec (k+m) v c = c.
Proof.
  induction c; intros k m v H; simpl in *; auto.
  - (* c_var_b *) assert (Hlt : n < k + m) by lia.
    destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n (k+m)) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; auto; lia.
  - (* arrow *) rewrite IHc1; auto. rewrite IHc2; auto.
  - (* seq *) rewrite IHc1; auto. rewrite IHc2; auto.
  - (* fixc *) rewrite IHc with (k:=S k) (m:=m); auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_b_almost : forall c k v,
  lc_b (S k) v -> lc_b k (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k v c) -> lc_b (S k) c.
Proof.
  induction c; intros k v Hv Hop; simpl in *; auto.
  - (* c_var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H1|H2]|H3].
    + lia.
    + subst. exact Hv.
    + lia.
  - (* arrow *) destruct Hop as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHc1 with (v:=v); auto.
    + apply IHc2 with (v:=v); auto.
  - (* seq *) destruct Hop as [H1 H2]. split.
    + apply IHc1 with (v:=v); auto.
    + apply IHc2 with (v:=v); auto.
  - (* fixc *) apply IHc with (k:=S k) (v:=v).
    + apply lc_b_mono with (k:=S k); auto. lia.
    + exact Hop.
Qed.

Lemma lc_b_castsubst : forall a x c k,
  lc_b 0 a -> lc_b k c -> lc_b k (castsubst_castop a x c).
Proof.
  induction c; intros k Ha Hc; simpl in *; auto.
  - (* c_var_f *) destruct (eq_dec c0 x); auto.
    apply lc_b_mono with (k:=0); auto. lia.
  - (* arrow *) destruct Hc as [H1 H2]. split; auto.
  - (* seq *) destruct Hc as [H1 H2]. split; auto.
  - (* fixc *) apply IHc with (k:=S k); auto.
Qed.

(* close/open identity: opening a closed atom at the same level is renaming *)
Lemma open_close_rename : forall c k x y,
  open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k (c_var_f y) (close_castop_wrt_castop_rec k x c)
  = castsubst_castop (c_var_f y) x c.
Proof.
  induction c; intros k x y; simpl.
  - (* c_var_b *) destruct (lt_dec n k) as [Hlt|Hnlt].
    + destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; auto; try lia.
    + destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec (S n) k) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; auto; try lia.
  - (* c_var_f *) destruct (eq_dec c0 x) as [Heq|Hne].
    + subst. simpl. destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec k k) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; try lia.
      destruct (eq_dec x x); auto. congruence.
    + simpl. destruct (eq_dec c0 x); congruence.
  - (* c_id *) reflexivity.
  - (* c_unfold *) reflexivity.
  - (* c_fold *) reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. rewrite IHc1. rewrite IHc2. reflexivity.
  - (* seq *) simpl. rewrite IHc1. rewrite IHc2. reflexivity.
  - (* fixc *) simpl. rewrite IHc. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* substitution commutes with opening, for a locally closed replacement *)
Lemma castsubst_open : forall c a x y k,
  lc_b 0 a -> x <> y ->
  castsubst_castop a x (open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k (c_var_f y) c)
  = open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k (c_var_f y) (castsubst_castop a x c).
Proof.
  induction c; intros a x y k Ha Hxy; simpl.
  - (* c_var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[H1|H2]|H3]; simpl; auto.
    + reflexivity.
    + subst. simpl. destruct (eq_dec y x); congruence.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* c_var_f *) destruct (eq_dec c0 x) as [Heq|Hne].
    + subst. simpl. rewrite (lc_b_open_id a 0 k (c_var_f y) Ha). reflexivity.
    + simpl. destruct (eq_dec c0 x); congruence.
  - (* c_id *) reflexivity.
  - (* c_unfold *) reflexivity.
  - (* c_fold *) reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. rewrite IHc1; auto. rewrite IHc2; auto.
  - (* seq *) simpl. rewrite IHc1; auto. rewrite IHc2; auto.
  - (* fixc *) simpl. rewrite IHc; auto.
Qed.

Corollary open_closed_cast : forall c k v, lc_b 0 c -> open_castop_wrt_castop_rec k v c = c.
Proof.
  intros. eapply lc_b_open_id with (k:=0) (m:=k). exact H.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma TypCast_sound_gen : forall D E A B c,
  TypCast D E A B c ->
  forall H, (forall x p, In (x,p) E -> In p H) -> eqe2 D H A B.
Proof.
  intros D E A B c Ht.
  induction Ht; intros Hctx Hin.
  - (* id *) apply e2_refl; auto.
  - (* arrow *)
    apply e2_arrfix.
    + apply eqe2_weaken with (H := Hctx).
      * apply IHHt1. intros x p Hinp. exact (Hin x p Hinp).
      * intros p Hp. simpl. right. exact Hp.
    + apply eqe2_weaken with (H := Hctx).
      * apply IHHt2. intros x p Hinp. exact (Hin x p Hinp).
      * intros p Hp. simpl. right. exact Hp.
  - (* unfold *) apply e2_fld; auto.
  - (* fold *) apply e2_symm. apply e2_fld; auto.
  - (* seq *) eapply e2_trans; eauto.
  - (* var *)
    apply e2_assump.
    + exact (Hin cx (A, B) H2).
    + exact H.
    + exact H0.
  - (* fix *)
    destruct (atom_fresh L) as [cx Hfresh].
    apply e2_arrfix.
    + apply H0 with (cx := cx).
      * exact Hfresh.
      * intros x p Hinp. simpl in Hinp. simpl.
        destruct Hinp as [Heq | Hinp].
        -- left. injection Heq as _ Heqp. exact Heqp.
        -- right. exact (Hin x p Hinp).
    + apply H2 with (cx := cx).
      * exact Hfresh.
      * intros x p Hinp. simpl in Hinp. simpl.
        destruct Hinp as [Heq | Hinp].
        -- left. injection Heq as _ Heqp. exact Heqp.
        -- right. exact (Hin x p Hinp).
Qed.

Theorem TypCast_soundness: forall D A B c,
  TypCast D nil A B c ->
  eqe2 D nil A B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply TypCast_sound_gen with (E := nil) (H := nil).
  - exact H.
  - intros x p Hnil. inversion Hnil.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Locally closed cast operators (no free bound variables)      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Substitution of a context variable by an actual cast         *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma in_dom_iff : forall (E:cctx) z, z `in` dom E <-> exists p, In (z,p) E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [| [a q] E' IH]; intro z.
  - simpl. split.
    + intro H. apply empty_iff in H. destruct H.
    + intros [p H]. inversion H.
  - simpl. split.
    + intro H. destruct (eq_dec z a) as [Heq|Hne].
      * subst. exists q. left. reflexivity.
      * apply (AtomSetImpl.add_3 (s:=dom E') (x:=a) (y:=z)) in H.
        -- apply IH in H. destruct H as [p Hp]. exists p. right. exact Hp.
        -- intro he. apply Hne. symmetry. exact he.
    + intros [p H]. simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
      * injection Heq as Hz Hp. subst. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1. reflexivity.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH. exists p. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_in_eq : forall (E:cctx) x p q,
  uniq E -> In (x,p) E -> In (x,q) E -> p = q.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [| [a r] E' IH]; intros x p q Hu H1 H2.
  - inversion H1.
  - apply uniq_cons_iff in Hu. destruct Hu as [Hu Ha].
    simpl in H1, H2. destruct H1 as [Heq1|H1]; destruct H2 as [Heq2|H2].
    + injection Heq1 as _ Hp. injection Heq2 as _ Hq. subst. reflexivity.
    + injection Heq1 as Hx Hp. subst x p.
      exfalso. apply Ha. apply in_dom_iff. exists q. exact H2.
    + injection Heq2 as Hx Hq. subst x q.
      exfalso. apply Ha. apply in_dom_iff. exists p. exact H1.
    + apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma in_app_cons_split : forall (E1 E2:cctx) x A B cx p,
  In (cx,p) (E1 ++ (x,(A,B))::E2) ->
  (cx = x /\ p = (A,B)) \/ In (cx,p) (E1++E2).
Proof.
  intros E1 E2 x A B cx p H.
  apply List.in_app_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
  - right. apply List.in_app_iff. left. exact H.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq|H].
    + left. injection Heq as Hcx Hp. split; assumption.
    + right. apply List.in_app_iff. right. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_remove_mid : forall (E1 E2:cctx) x A B,
  uniq (E1 ++ (x,(A,B))::E2) -> uniq (E1++E2).
Proof.
  intros E1. induction E1 as [| [a p] E1' IH]; intros E2 x A B H.
  - simpl in *. apply (uniq_cons_1 (typ*typ) x (A,B) E2 H).
  - simpl in H. apply uniq_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [Hu Ha].
    simpl. apply uniq_cons_3.
    + apply IH. exact Hu.
    + intro Hin. apply Ha. apply in_dom_iff in Hin. destruct Hin as [q Hq].
      apply in_dom_iff. exists q.
      apply List.in_app_iff in Hq. destruct Hq as [Hq|Hq].
      * apply List.in_app_iff. left. exact Hq.
      * apply List.in_app_iff. right. simpl. right. exact Hq.
Qed.

Lemma TypCast_subst_gen : forall D E P Q c,
  TypCast D E P Q c ->
  forall E1 x A B E2, E = E1 ++ (x,(A,B))::E2 ->
  uniq (E1 ++ (x,(A,B))::E2) ->
  forall c0, TypCast D (E1++E2) A B c0 ->
  TypCast D (E1++E2) P Q (castsubst_castop c0 x c).
Proof.
  intros D E P Q c H.
  induction H as [D E P Hwf Huniq
                | D E P1 Q1 P2 Q2 c1 c2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                | D E T Hwf Huniq
                | D E T Hwf Huniq
                | D E P R c1 c2 Q H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                | D E P Q cx H1 H2 H3 H4
                | L D E A1 B1 A2 B2 c1 c2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2];
  intros E1 x A B E2 HE Hu c0 Hc0.
  - (* id *)
    simpl. apply TCast_id; auto. apply uniq_remove_mid with (x:=x) (A:=A) (B:=B). exact Hu.
  - (* arrow *)
    simpl. apply TCast_arrow.
    + apply (IH1 E1 x A B E2); auto.
    + apply (IH2 E1 x A B E2); auto.
  - (* unfold *)
    simpl. apply TCast_unfold; auto. apply uniq_remove_mid with (x:=x) (A:=A) (B:=B). exact Hu.
  - (* fold *)
    simpl. apply TCast_fold; auto. apply uniq_remove_mid with (x:=x) (A:=A) (B:=B). exact Hu.
  - (* seq *)

  - (* var *)

      * exact H2.
      * apply uniq_remove_mid with (x:=x) (A:=A) (B:=B). exact Hu.
      * exact Hin.
  - (* fix *)
    simpl in *.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Completeness: every equivalence has a cast, both directions  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma eqe2_complete_both : forall D H A B,
  eqe2 D H A B ->
  forall E, realizes H E ->
  (exists c, TypCast D E A B c) /\ (exists c, TypCast D E B A c).
Proof.
  intros D H A B Hd.
  induction Hd as [D H A B Hin HwfA HwfB
                | D H A Hwf
                | D H A C B H1 IH1 H2 IH2
                | D H B A H1 IH1
                | D H A Hwf
                | D H A1 A2 B1 B2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2];
  intros E [Hu Hcov].
  - (* assump *)
    destruct (Hcov (A,B) Hin) as [[x Hx] [y Hy]]. split.
    + exists (c_var_f x). apply TCast_var with (cx:=x); auto.
    + exists (c_var_f y). apply TCast_var with (cx:=y); auto.
  - (* refl *)
    split.
    + exists c_id. apply TCast_id; auto.
    + exists c_id. apply TCast_id; auto.
  - (* trans *)

    destruct (IH2 E (conj Hu Hcov)) as [[c2 Hc2] [d2 Hd2]].
    split.
    + exists (c_seq c1 c2). eapply TCast_seq; eauto.
    + exists (c_seq d2 d1). eapply TCast_seq; eauto.
  - (* symm *)
    destruct (IH1 E (conj Hu Hcov)) as [[c Hc] [d Hd]]. split.
    + exists d. exact Hd.
    + exists c. exact Hc.

    + exists (c_unfold (t_mu A)). apply TCast_unfold; auto.
    + exists (c_fold (t_mu A)). apply TCast_fold; auto.

    assert (Hb : b `notin` dom E) by (apply fresh_cons_elements_notin).

## Result

`/workspace/Task.v` now contains complete proofs of both required declarations:

- `TypCast_soundness : TypCast D nil A B c -> eqe2 D nil A B`
- `TypCast_completeness : eqe2 D nil A B -> exists c, TypCast D nil A B c`

- `make` (from the project root, after `make clean`) exits `0`.

## Proof outline

**Soundness** — a generalized lemma `TypCast_sound_gen` interprets a cast derivation in any context `E` as an `eqe2` derivation in any context `H` containing `E`'s pairs. `TCast_fix` is matched by `e2_arrfix` using `atom_fresh`; `TCast_unfold/fold` map to `e2_fld`/its symmetric version, and `TCast_var` to `e2_assump` via the context inclusion. This needs a monotonicity lemma for `eqe2`.

**Completeness** — proved as a simultaneous “both directions” induction on the `eqe2` derivation:

```
eqe2 D H A B -> realizes H E ->
  (exists c, TypCast D E A B c) /\ (exists c, TypCast D E B A c)
```

where `realizes H E` says `E` is `uniq` and holds a variable for every pair in `H` *and* for its flip. The hard `e2_arrfix` case uses a doubled context containing both a pair `P` and `flip P`; casts for both directions of the premises are obtained from the induction hypotheses, the reverse of the fix-point assumption is rebuilt with a nested `TCast_fix`, and the auxiliary assumption is then eliminated by a substitution (cut) lemma.

Supporting infrastructure developed in `Task.v`:
- locally-closed cast operators (`lc_b`), and commutation/identity lemmas for `open_castop`/`close_castop`/`castsubst_castop`;
- `TypCast` weakening, permutation, atom-renaming, and variable substitution (cut) lemmas;
- context utilities (`subst_ctx`, `flip_ctx`, freshness and `dom` lemmas, the `realizes` relation and its “doubled-context” introduction lemmas).
